title: Pro-etale covering of a scheme
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A family of morphisms of schemes $\{f_i:U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ is a *pro-etale covering* if every $f_i$ is weakly etale [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism] and the family is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]: for every affine open $V\subset U$ there are finitely many indices $i_1,\dots,i_n$ and affine opens $V_j\subset U_{i_j}$ with $\bigcup_j f_{i_j}(V_j)=V$.

source.place: Bhatt-Scholze, The pro-etale topology for schemes, Definition 4.1.1, p. 27 (covers of X_proet are the families that are covers in the fpqc topology)
